Model Conversation Relay

Relay one exact exchange with an already bound ChatGPT advisory conversation. Preserve the caller's request, the other model's response and their origins, while leaving interpretation, correctness and task acceptance with the caller.

Read SKILL.md for the complete method. Examples: continue waiting for an acknowledged request; reconcile an interrupted first submission; submit an authorized exact follow-up once; retain an immutable receipt for the bound answer. This relay does not create or select conversations, change models or rewrite either side of the exchange.

Install and bind

Install model-conversation-relay@boluopai through the collection's Codex instructions, or obtain this complete directory through GitHub source and your client's supported Skill mechanism. Installation supplies instructions, not account access, message authorization, browser control or a running service.

Capability or companion Actual requirement
Caller and private task storage Required: exact conversation/mode/readiness binding, authorized operation, exact request bytes and SHA-256, prior turn/attempt evidence, and a private location for immutable request, response and receipt files. The caller retains surrounding task/source provenance and answer judgment.
Native conversation adapter Conditional: a currently exposed tool and schema that address the exact target and expose sufficient ordered-turn, running and acknowledgement evidence. The Codex App tool names in the entrypoint are examples, not portable API guarantees. Observe and send are separate capabilities and authorities.
Browser Relay Required only for the selected Browser Relay route: install browser-relay@boluopai, read its complete entrypoint and bind a recipient-configured controlled carrier, intended authenticated account, target custody and lifecycle. It does not install a browser controller or grant login access.
Host continuation and credential owners Supply supported waiting/resumption, actual login/consent boundaries and safe desktop behavior. A note does not schedule a wake-up; without supported continuation report the retained pending exchange.
cloud-local-workflow Optional host-specific provenance owner when already present. It is not a public collection member or installation prerequisite. Without it, retain task, source, model-selection and first-submission evidence in the caller's existing records.

Keep transport receipts, actual conversations, account/profile identifiers and private requests outside the public package, plugin cache and public repository. Resolve all bindings from the recipient's current host; no author account, credential, profile, path or conversation is supplied here.

Evidence and limits

The method freezes target and request identity, reconciles ordered turns before mutation, keeps one attempt in flight and treats acknowledged sends as pending even before a remote turn becomes visible. An idle target or observation lag does not authorize a resend. Explicit non-acceptance or an observed terminal incomplete response can justify only the exact retry allowed by the entrypoint. Interruption recovery retains acknowledgement and retry history instead of resetting them.

A completed transport receipt binds an observed response to its request and target; it does not certify the answer's correctness, evidence quality or task completion. Keep the original response intact when evaluating or forwarding it.

Package/discovery checks and offline reconciliation scenarios can establish delivery and inspect decision boundaries without sending a message. Actual authenticated transport, provider completeness signals and continuation must be verified on the recipient's real authorized exchange. Installing, authoring or testing this Skill supplies no authorization for a test advisory message.

This public adaptation preserves the local exchange, reconciliation, waiting, retry, provenance and receipt method, with recipient-resolved host bindings and an optional provenance companion.
